Cloudflare Web Analytics, without the clicks

The official page makes reading your own traffic slower than it should be. Here is what My Web Dash does instead.

  • CloudflareIt opens on performance, so traffic is always a click away.

    My Web DashIt opens on traffic. Visitors and top pages come first.

What My Web Dash does

  • Traffic first

    Visitors, top pages, and referrers are the first thing you see, not Core Web Vitals. Read your traffic without clicking through.

  • Your place is kept

    Your current view lives in the URL, so a refresh or a shared link lands right where you left off, not back at page one.

  • Period over period at a glance

    Every site shows its change versus the previous period on the card, so you see what is up or down without opening a detail page.

  • All your sites in one place

    Connect every Cloudflare account you manage and see all your sites in one grid you can sort and search.

  • Filter and drill down

    Slice by country, path, referrer, browser, or device, and stack filters to drill down, with more than 30 days of history.

  • One click connect, read only

    Connect through Cloudflare official OAuth. No API tokens to generate, no write access, and you can disconnect anytime.

The Cloudflare analytics API, without writing it

Cloudflare exposes web analytics through a GraphQL API. This is what pulling one metric looks like by hand. My Web Dash does this for every site for you.

From scattered pages to one fast view

Frequently asked questions

What is My Web Dash?

My Web Dash is a faster view of your Cloudflare Web Analytics. It reads your Cloudflare traffic and shows it in one place, traffic first, keeping your filters and your place as you navigate, across every site you run.

How is it different from the Cloudflare analytics dashboard?

The Cloudflare page opens on performance metrics, paginates in the browser so a refresh loses your place, and only shows period over period inside a site detail page. My Web Dash puts traffic first, keeps your view in the URL, shows the change on every site card, and brings all your sites together.

Do you get access to my Cloudflare account?

You connect through Cloudflare official OAuth with read only access to analytics. There is no write access, and you can disconnect anytime.

Is My Web Dash affiliated with Cloudflare?

No. My Web Dash is an independent tool and is not affiliated with Cloudflare, Inc.

What data can I see?

Pageviews, visitors, top pages, referrers, countries, browsers, and devices for every site, with filter and exclude so you can drill down, and period over period on every site.

Does it slow down my site?

No. There is nothing to add to your sites. My Web Dash reads Cloudflare Web Analytics through the official API.

How much does it cost?

Pricing is by the number of sites you bring into your dashboard, starting free for up to 10 sites. Prices are announced at launch.

When can I use it?

Sign in with Google and connect your Cloudflare account to start seeing your traffic. Pricing is announced at launch.

Which analytics does it read?

It reads Cloudflare Web Analytics through Cloudflare official GraphQL API. There is no script to add to your sites.

Stop clicking through the Cloudflare dashboard

A faster view of your Cloudflare Web Analytics, traffic first, across every site you run.

与您已经使用的东西一起使用

My Web Dash 通过 Cloudflare 官方 OAuth 连接，只读。 使用 Google 登录。 您的网站上无需安装任何内容。

  • 云耀
  • GraphQL API
  • 谷歌

Cloudflare Web Analytics，无需点击

官方页面使读取您自己的流量比应有的速度慢。 以下是 My Web Dash 所做的事情。

  • CloudflareIt 以性能为基础打开，因此只需点击一下即可获得流量。My Web DashIt 以流量为基础打开。 访客和首页是第一位的。

My Web Dash 的用途

  • 流量第一访客、热门页面和引荐来源网址是您首先看到的东西，而不是核心网络生命力。 无需点击即可读取您的流量。
  • 您的位置将保留您当前的视图位于 URL 中，因此刷新或共享链接会位于您上次停下的位置，而不是返回到第一页。
  • 每个站点都会在卡片上显示其与上一时期相比的变化，因此您无需打开详细信息页面即可看到上升或下降的情况。
  • 您的所有站点都集中在一个地方连接您管理的每个 Cloudflare 帐户，并在一个网格中查看您的所有站点，您可以对其进行排序和搜索。
  • 过滤和向下钻取按国家/地区、路径、引荐来源网址、浏览器或设备进行切片，并堆叠过滤器进行向下钻取，具有超过 30 天的历史记录。
  • 一键连接，只读通过 Cloudflare 官方 OAuth 连接。 无需生成 API 令牌，无需写入访问权限，并且您可以随时断开连接。

Cloudflare 分析 API，无需编写

Cloudflare 通过 GraphQL API 公开 Web 分析。 这就是手动提取一个指标的样子。 My Web Dash 为您的每个网站执行此操作。

从分散的页面到快速查看

常见问题

我的网络短跑是什么？

My Web Dash 是您的 Cloudflare Web Analytics 的更快视图。 它会读取您的 Cloudflare 流量并将其显示在一个位置（流量第一），在您运行的每个站点上导航时保留您的过滤器和位置。

它与 Cloudflare 分析仪表板有何不同？

Cloudflare 页面根据性能指标打开，在浏览器中分页，因此刷新会丢失您的位置，并且仅在站点详细信息页面内显示一段时间。 My Web Dash 将流量放在首位，将您的视图保留在 URL 中，在每个站点卡上显示更改，并将所有站点集中在一起。

您可以访问我的 Cloudflare 帐户吗？

您通过 Cloudflare 官方 OAuth 进行连接，并具有对分析的只读访问权限。 没有写入权限，您可以随时断开连接。

My Web Dash 隶属于 Cloudflare 吗？

不。My Web Dash 是一个独立的工具，不隶属于 Cloudflare, Inc.。

我可以看到什么数据？

每个网站的综合浏览量、访问者、热门页面、引荐来源网址、国家/地区、浏览器和设备，并具有筛选和排除功能，以便您可以深入了解每个网站的不同时期。

它会减慢我的网站速度吗？

不。没有任何内容可以添加到您的网站。 My Web Dash 通过官方 API 读取 Cloudflare Web Analytics。

它要多少钱？

定价根据您引入仪表板的网站数量而定，最多 10 个网站免费。 价格在发布时公布。

我什么时候可以使用它？

使用 Google 登录并连接您的 Cloudflare 帐户以开始查看您的流量。 定价在发布时公布。

它读取哪些分析？

它通过 Cloudflare 官方 GraphQL API 读取 Cloudflare Web Analytics。 没有可添加到您的站点的脚本。
